verdict.rationale: ClickHouse documents a free path to real prototypes: it is open source and can be run on your own machine 'to build, test, and experiment.' The Cloud pricing evidence only describes usage-based billing that scales to zero when idle, not a free hosted tier or trial. missing for 10: a documented ClickHouse Cloud free tier or trial credits with stated limits, evidence on how usable that tier is for real prototypes, independent founder corroboration of prototyping at no cost.

support.subject: As a founder, a genuinely usable free tier lets me run real prototypes before paying

citations.quote: Run ClickHouse on your own machine to build, test, and experiment.
ClickHouse is a fast open-source column-oriented database management system (DBMS)
Usage-based pricing: pay only for the compute and storage you use, scaled separately and down to zero when idle.
